procedures.title: Microgravity Cardiac Arrest & CPR Protocol
procedures.indication: Unresponsive astronaut, absence of normal breathing, pulseless electrical activity or asystole.

steps.title: Secure Astronaut to CMRS
steps.description: Immediately secure patient to the Crew Medical Restraint System (CMRS) board. Attach operator foot loops or hand tethers to counter reaction forces in microgravity.

steps.title: Assess Rhythm & Attach Defibrillator
steps.description: Expose chest, clean skin of conductive perspiration, and apply AED/defibrillator pads (Antero-lateral placement). Follow AED voice prompt.

steps.title: Deliver Shock if Advised (VF/pVT)
steps.description: Ensure no crew member is in direct contact with patient or CMRS conductive frame. Deliver shock immediately if indicated by AED.

steps.title: Initiate Microgravity Chest Compressions
steps.description: Deliver continuous chest compressions at 100-120 cpm, depth 5-6 cm. Use handstand technique (pushing against opposing cabin bulkhead) or CMRS waist harness.

steps.title: Airway Management & 100% O2
steps.description: Insert supraglottic airway or seal BVM with 100% supplemental oxygen. 1 breath every 6 seconds without interrupting compressions.

steps.title: Administer Epinephrine
steps.description: Obtain IV or sternal IO access. Administer Epinephrine 1 mg IV/IO every 3-5 minutes. Log lot number and time in ASTRA.

procedures.title: Emergency Hypoxia & Supplemental Oxygen Protocol
procedures.indication: Peripheral SpO2 < 88% or acute cabin depressurization / suit disconnect.

steps.title: Immediate Donning of Quick-Don Mask
steps.description: Don emergency Quick-Don O2 mask within 5 seconds. Verify positive seal and continuous positive pressure airflow.

steps.title: Verify Cabin Partial Pressure
steps.description: Cross-check spacecraft environmental telemetry: check Cabin Total Pressure (>14.7 psi / 101.3 kPa) and ppO2 (>160 mmHg).

steps.title: Check Suit Umbilical / Local Atmosphere
steps.description: If on EVA or suit umbilical, inspect supply lines for kink, pressure drop, or atmospheric leak.

steps.title: Administer High-Flow Oxygen
steps.description: Set delivery to 15 L/min high-flow 100% O2 via non-rebreather mask until SpO2 stabilizes above 95%.

steps.title: Clinical Re-assessment & Neurological Check
steps.description: Evaluate mental status, pupillary reflexes, and perform finger-to-nose coordination to rule out cerebral hypoxia.

procedures.title: Toxic Atmosphere & Chemical Scrubber Breakthrough
procedures.indication: Cabin CO2 > 6.0 mmHg, ammonia vapor detection, or smoke generation.
equipment_required: Emergency Atmospheric Scrubbing Canister (LiOH / Trace Contaminant)
Ammonia Dräger Test Tubes / Multi-Gas Detector

steps.title: Don Respiratory Protection
steps.description: All crew members immediately don emergency full-face breathing masks with autonomous supply.

steps.title: Isolate Affected Module
steps.description: Close inter-module pressure hatches to compartmentalize contaminated volume.

steps.title: Activate Contingency Air Scrubbing
steps.description: Switch Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) to emergency high-rate scrubber mode. Replace LiOH canisters.

steps.title: Monitor Crew Vitals for Toxicity
steps.description: Continuous monitoring of crew SpO2, respiratory rate, and blood carboxyhemoglobin indicators.

procedures.title: Acute Solar Particle Event (SPE) Radiation Countermeasures
procedures.indication: Dosimeter dose rate > 500 uSv/hr or Space Weather Warning RED issued by Deep Space Network.
equipment_required: Radiation Storm Shelter Water Wall Packs

steps.title: Maneuver Crew to Storm Shelter
steps.description: Move all crew members into the heavily shielded core storm shelter (water wall / logistics shielding configuration).

steps.title: Dock Active Personal Dosimeters
steps.description: Verify personal dosimeters are active and synchronized with ASTRA telemetry mesh.

steps.title: Administer Prophylactic Antiemetics if Symptomatic
steps.description: If prodromal nausea occurs, administer Promethazine 25mg orally or IM per medical officer directive.

steps.title: ALARA Shielding Verification
steps.description: Audit shielding density and ensure stowage bags are oriented along the solar proton flux vector.

procedures.title: Orthostatic Countermeasure & Saline Rehydration Protocol
procedures.indication: Pulse pressure < 25 mmHg, pre-syncopal lightheadedness upon reorientation or EVA egress.
equipment_required: Oral Electrolyte Rehydration Salts (ORS) / Saline IV

steps.title: Position Crew in Neutral Body Posture
steps.description: Restrain astronaut in comfortable neutral body posture with legs slightly elevated to promote venous return.

steps.title: Oral Electrolyte Loading
steps.description: Administer 1.0 Liter of chilled isotonic electrolyte fluid over 45 minutes to restore circulating plasma volume.

steps.title: Apply Compression Countermeasures
steps.description: Don and inflate lower body compression garment (gradient pressure: 40-50 mmHg at calves, 30 mmHg at thighs).

steps.title: Continuous Blood Pressure Monitoring
steps.description: Re-evaluate blood pressure every 10 minutes until systolic BP > 105 mmHg and pulse pressure > 35 mmHg.
